academy.abilityText: When you gain an Action card, +1 Villager.

barracks.abilityText: At the start of your turn, +1 Action.

canal.abilityText: During your turns, cards cost $1 less.

capitalism.abilityText: During your turns, Actions with +$ amounts in their text are also Treasures.

cathedral.abilityText: At the start of your turn, trash a card from your hand.

citadel.abilityText: The first time you play an Action card during each of your turns, replay it afterwards.

city-gate.abilityText: At the start of your turn, +1 Card, then put a card from your hand onto your deck.

crop-rotation.abilityText: At the start of your turn, you may discard a Victory card for +2 Cards.

exploration.abilityText: At the end of your Buy phase, if you didn't gain any cards during it, +1 Coffers and +1 Villager.

fair.abilityText: At the start of your turn, +1 Buy.

fleet.abilityText: After the game ends, there's an extra round of turns just for players with this.

guildhall.abilityText: When you gain a Treasure, +1 Coffers.

innovation.abilityText: Once during each of your turns, when you gain an Action card, you may play it.

pageant.abilityText: At the end of your Buy phase, you may pay $1 for +1 Coffers.

piazza.abilityText: At the start of your turn, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an Action, play it.

road-network.abilityText: When another player gains a Victory card, +1 Card.

sewers.abilityText: When you trash a card other than with this, you may trash a card from your hand.

silos.abilityText: At the start of your turn, discard any number of Coppers, revealed, and draw that many cards.

sinister-plot.abilityText: At the start of your turn, add a token here, or remove your tokens here for +1 Card each.

star-chart.abilityText: When shuffling, you may pick one of the cards to go on top.
